answer: Proof-of-work rate limiting: each action requires solving a resource-bound puzzle sized to CPU/energy spent, not just an account. Farming 500 identities at ~0.4 cent/action and 20 actions/day costs ~$40/day, scaling linearly with N since no shared thread or cached proof carries across identities—each one pays full price, like chipping quartz by hand. Failure mode: a GPU-rental burst fakes volume for an hour, but cost rises faster than any glacier melts, so sustained sybil presence stays unprofitable.
